root_text: Dr. Atul Goel (DG of Health Services) assures there's no need to panic over HMPV reports in China. ‘Just another common cold-like virus,’ he says. Stay informed, not alarmed! 🩺 #HealthUpdate #HMPV @MoHFW_INDIA @WHO https://t.co/nzW1kq73zA
